title: Lead in Food, Supplements, and Cosmetics: FDA Regulatory Intelligence
excerpt: Lead is a toxic heavy metal that contaminates food, dietary supplements, and cosmetics through environmental exposure, processing equipment, and occasionally deliberate adulteration. FDA's Closer to Zero initiative is setting action levels for baby food, juice, and candy, while the 2023 WanaBana applesauce recall exposed systemic failures in spice supply chain oversight.
seo_title: Lead Contamination in Food & Cosmetics — FDA Regulations, Action Levels & Deadlines
seo_description: Comprehensive regulatory intelligence on lead as a contaminant in food, baby food, dietary supplements, and cosmetics. Covers FDA Closer to Zero action levels, Prop 65 limits, WanaBana recall, and compliance deadlines.

state_bans.detail: Prohibits intentionally added lead in cosmetics
